data.name: Earthquake
data.description: A mythic great cyclops can punch the ground and expend two uses of mythic power to cause an earthquake (as the spell). Add the cyclops's rank to the save DCs for the earthquake's effects. Other mythic great cyclopes are not affected by the earthquake.
